stories.body:
A friend just Googled his own kid.

His son is 19. Dropped out after one semester. 

Kid stopped asking for money around February. That scared him more than the dropping out.

First result. A podcast clip. His kid saying he made thirty thousand in 30 days off Fortnite maps.

$8,400 month one. $30,000 last month. His best month hit $82,370. His dad makes $54,000 a year. With overtime.

The kid uses the free Fortnite editor and Claude. $20 a month.

He called me that night. His kid doesn't code. Not a single line. He tells Claude what to build and it writes everything.

First map took him one weekend. That was January. His kid's been getting a payout every month since.

I looked it up after. 70,000 people are getting paid for this. Two years ago it was 24,000.

The kid had less than you do right now.

His whole process is in the article.

Most people will never try.
stories.notes: Inspirational story of a dropout kid earning big with AI-assisted Fortnite maps, discovered via a podcast clip. Different from excluded topics.
